title: CraftableStuff
description: This vanilla-friendly mod allows you to craft many stuff that is uncraftable.
body:
A vanilla-Friendly mod that allows to craft many uncraftable items, and brings some new potions. It includes:
1. Trident
2. Chainmail Armor
3. Enchanted Apple
4. Saddle (like in newer versions)
5. Bundle (like in newer versions)
6. Bell
7. New variant of Red Dye craft
8. Lead and Lodestone changed craft (like in newer versions)
9. Luck, Unluck, Haste, Health Boost and Nausea potions with its crafts

I've done this mod for myself using MCreator, but I think that it may be useful for someone else.
